consequence.statement: When service accounts are not created, the rendered Deployments now carry the configured image pull secrets. Nothing is described as failing.

original.statement: When service accounts are not created, the cert-manager chart's Deployments now include image pull secrets.

decision.reason: [ev-772ebf21cd9f] says only that image pull secrets are now added to deployments when service accounts aren't created. That changes the rendered Deployments in those environments without any stated failure, rejection or dropped setting, so a low-severity behavior-change (review) fits better than a failure kind. It also fits better than "none", because the pod spec actually changes. The word "configured" in the statement is a mild inference, but it doesn't change the kind or the class.
